_what_this_is: The search behind `published_comparison`, recorded at its real size. It is a SMALLER screen than alirocumab-lipid's, which read 101 records at abstract level, and saying so is the same discipline as stating a denominator: a search reported at more than its size is a selection presented as a survey.
transport: PubMed E-utilities via the bio-research MCP server
query: inclisiran AND (meta-analysis[Publication Type] OR systematic review[Publication Type] OR meta-analysis[Title])
query_translation_returned_by_pubmed: ("aln pcs"[Supplementary Concept] OR "aln pcs"[All Fields] OR "inclisiran"[All Fields]) AND ("meta-analysis"[Publication Type] OR "systematic review"[Publication Type] OR "meta-analysis"[Title])
why_not_all_were_appraised: The 10 appraised were the 10 highest-relevance records, and 4 of them turned out to be directly comparable including one over what the arithmetic says are this review's own three trials. THE REMAINING 51 WERE NOT READ. This is a real limit and it is stated rather than implied: a further synthesis of these same three trials could exist among them, and if one does, this comparison has missed it.
what_would_complete_it: Reading the remaining 51 abstracts and recording a per-record decision for each, as ssot/alirocumab-lipid/appraisal/PUBLISHED_SYNTHESIS_SCREEN.json does for 101.

appraised.why: pools inclisiran against placebo on LDL-C percent change; n = 3,660 over 3 RCTs, which is exactly this review's three trials by arithmetic
reports inclisiran 284 mg LDL-C percent change separately from the PCSK9 antibodies, so a like-for-like number exists
real-world observational, a different design answering the same clinical question -- included because the contrast is the point
network meta-analysis placing inclisiran against other agents; a different question, included so the reader can see it was considered
network meta-analysis reporting inclisiran versus statins, not versus placebo; no comparable placebo-controlled percent-change value
network meta-analysis on a standardised-difference scale, not percent change
network meta-analysis of add-on therapy to maximally tolerated statins; different population frame
